item.title: Choose Between Two Gifts
item.prompt_text: A craft stall sells a small bowl with blue stripes and a taller bowl with green dots. The bowls cost the same. Your friend needs something small that will fit on a narrow shelf. Tell the seller which one you want, why you chose it and how you would like it packed.
item.target_grammar: Comparatives for size and can you for a request.
item.fluency_objective: State the choice first. Give the reason before asking the seller to pack the bowl.
item.pronunciation_objective: Stress blue stripes and narrow shelf so it is clear which bowl you mean and why.

cues.text: Explain why it fits your friend's needs.

item.model_opening: I'd like the bowl with blue stripes, please.
item.model_answer: I'd like the bowl with blue stripes, please. I like both bowls, but this one is smaller. My friend has a narrow shelf beside her desk, and the green bowl might be too tall. The blue one can go beside a little plant. Can you wrap it in paper and put it in a small bag? I need to carry it home on the bus.
